answer: Divergent response forfeit: each identity is paired and sent complementary challenges seeded from a zephyr source, requiring different signed outputs. Clones share state, so identical answers on both branches reveal the copy and revoke the pair. Pairings rotate under a mesa schedule to prevent prearranged splits. The attacker pays a unique key store, independent entropy/clock, and per-round signing/bandwidth for every identity; sharing any collapses the set, and each opal receipt must carry fresh entropy.
